answer: A Bank-verified account bound by challenge-response signature with a ninety-day rotation cooldown ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the bank-verified account answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A wander that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. A walnut and a opal may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
